collection_notes: Steps 4-6 (open-web and T3 press searches) could not be completed for every candidate because the WebSearch budget shared by all agents in this run ran out (searches marked 'blocked' in collection_log were not run); searches that did run produced no items that were used. To keep effort equal, no T3 items are included for any candidate in the US Senate, US House 1-6 or Governor races: every item comes from the T1 voters' pamphlet, official .gov pages or official roll-call pages. Campaign websites are recorded from the pamphlet but were not fetched for positions, for any candidate. oregonlive.com and apnews.com are rejected by the search proxy as allowed_domains and could not be searched for anyone. incumbent=false because the pamphlet edition cited in incumbent_source_url lists another candidate in this race as the sitting officeholder. Pamphlet (Deschutes edition) lists Beck as Democrat, Independent; matches inventory. Promising general-election T3 items exist for both candidates (OPB 2026-09-30 'Chris Beck puts rural health care at the center of his race against Cliff Bentz'; KOIN 'Cliff Bentz shares his stance on key issues ahead of midterms') but were not fetched, to keep T3 treatment identical across all assigned races.
